variantComparison.label: Asymmetric Runner (Live Bot)
variantComparison.activationThreshold: Locks Breakeven at +1.0 pt, locks +1.0 pt at +1.3 pts; unlocks Runner at 85% TP
variantComparison.stopDistanceRule: Progressive multi-tier: trail 7.0 pts at +12 pts, 10.0 pts at +22 pts, 15.0 pts at +38 pts
variantComparison.updateFrequency: Bar-by-bar ratchet upon each closed bar's extreme
variantComparison.exitRule: Hit dynamic trailing stop floor, initial SL, or extended runner TP target

variantComparison.label: Fixed-Distance Trail (4.0 pts)
variantComparison.activationThreshold: Activates when peak profit reaches +4.0 points ($4.00/oz)
variantComparison.stopDistanceRule: Fixed 4.0 points behind highest high (LONG) or lowest low (SHORT)
variantComparison.exitRule: Bid/Ask touches trailed stop level or initial TP

variantComparison.label: ATR Trailing (2.0x ATR)
variantComparison.activationThreshold: Activates when favorable excursion reaches 1.5 × ATR
variantComparison.stopDistanceRule: Trails at 2.0 × ATR below peak high (LONG) or above peak low (SHORT)
variantComparison.exitRule: Hit dynamic ATR trailing stop or initial TP

variantComparison.label: Breakeven Only (+0.2 buffer)
variantComparison.activationThreshold: Activates when profit reaches max(2.0 pts, 0.5 × initial SL distance)
variantComparison.stopDistanceRule: Moves SL to Entry Price + Spread + 0.20 pt friction buffer. No further movement
variantComparison.exitRule: Hit breakeven buffer or initial Take Profit

variantComparison.label: Profit-Triggered Trail (+1.2 at +2.5)
variantComparison.activationThreshold: Activates when favorable price move reaches +2.50 points
variantComparison.stopDistanceRule: Locks in +1.20 points of guaranteed profit
variantComparison.exitRule: Hit profit-locked stop or initial Take Profit

variantComparison.label: No Trailing (Fixed TP/SL Baseline)
variantComparison.stopDistanceRule: Static initial Stop Loss and initial Take Profit
variantComparison.exitRule: Only exits at initial Stop Loss or initial Take Profit

ablationMatrix.name: Ablation: Without Context Pattern Filter

ablationMatrix.name: Ablation: Without Spread Friction Guard

ablationMatrix.name: Ablation: Without London/NY Session Guard

ablationMatrix.name: Combination: Session + Spread Guard Only
ablationMatrix.description: Lightweight filtering: only executes in London/NY with spread friction guard active
